decisions.reason: Assigning Article 10 to the Culture category does not change the required author identity, photo source, or placement after the category label.
The Article 10 category mapping does not change the required size or circular shape of author photos.
The source assigns a category to a different article and does not alter the Dorian Vale article color restriction or the reservation of red for the cover.
Identifying Article 10 and its category does not change the requirement to source article content from the Civic Lantern website.
The category assignment contains no change to the magazine's polished, modern, brand-aligned visual style.
The Article 10 category mapping does not change the digital flipbook PDF deliverable.
The source makes no change to image-quality enhancement or the use of AI when enhancement is necessary.
The Article 10 category assignment does not affect the deferred print-ready output, its resolution, or its prepress settings.
